The wizard does not automatically advance to the date step after a service and provider are chosen via keyboard, forcing the user to manually press Next; however the Next button click handler does not advance because the provider may be cleared temporarily during the change event, causing the validation to fail and the step to remain unchanged.

The date picker's onMonthChange and onYearChange handlers trigger getUnavailableDates which then calls applyUnavailableDates with setDate:true, overriding the user‑typed date with the first enabled day of the month. We need to prevent this override when the date change is due to month/year navigation while the user has already entered a date.

The date picker's onMonthChange and onYearChange handlers trigger getUnavailableDates which then calls applyUnavailableDates with setDate:true, overriding the user‑typed date with the first enabled day of the month. We prevent this override by skipping the getUnavailableDates call when the date field's value matches the last user‑set date (from the onChange handler).

Pointer users experience a modal intercepting the date picker's next month button due to a JavaScript error triggered when the date field is cleared (causing getAvailableHours to be called with an empty string) or when month/year change handlers compute moments from undefined selected dates. We prevent these calls when no date is selected.

The date field is not focusable (div) preventing keyboard users from typing a date; after making it an input, the date picker's month/year change handlers override the user‑selected date with the first enabled day of the month. We prevent this override by storing the last user‑set date and skipping getUnavailableDates calls in onMonthChange/onYearChange when the picker's value matches that date.

In manage mode, clicking Next on the service/provider step resets the date to today and fetches unavailable dates for today, overriding the appointment date set by applyAppointmentData, causing the reopened booking to show the wrong date. Additionally, the date field must be an input to be focusable for keyboard users.
